title: Day 961: 37 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline — Knesset Kallner Bill Advancing Toward Late-May Plenum Vote; Beyachad Alliance Reaffirms Day-1 Independent Commission Pledge; NILI Campaign Continues
detail: On May 25, 2026 (Day 961 / Ceasefire Day 228), Israel's October 7 accountability crisis continued against the backdrop of the Supreme Court's July 1 deadline — now 37 days away — for the government to present a credible October 7 investigation framework, having been described by the High Court of Justice as an 'unacceptable' 32-month absence of any formal probe. The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill — authored by Likud MK Ariel Kallner — was advancing toward a late-May first Knesset plenum reading after clearing the Constitution, Law and Justice Committee (May 13). The bill has been substantially weakened from its original form: it dropped the phrase 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from its purpose clause; a Likud amendment bars current or former Supreme Court justices from serving; appointment requires a Knesset supermajority of 80 MKs, giving the opposition an effective veto. Attorney General Baharav-Miara has called the bill 'tailor-made for the government's personal needs'; President Herzog has warned it would 'significantly harm' the quest for truth; bereaved family organizations called it a 'political whitewash.' The opposition Beyachad alliance — formed by former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett and opposition leader Yair Lapid on May 11, 2026 — continued to frame the 2026 Israeli elections as a referendum on October 7 accountability, with an independent state commission as their pledged Day 1 governing priority. The NILI task force — revealed by the Wall Street Journal on May 21–22 — continues its systematic kill-or-capture campaign against all ~3,000 identified October 7 participants through the ceasefire period. A Hebrew University poll from April 2026 found 72% of Israelis support an independent inquiry; a JPPI poll (May 15) found 63% in support. Phase Two of the Gaza ceasefire remains in total deadlock; 857+ Palestinians killed since the October 10, 2025 ceasefire started (Day 228). IDF has documented 2,400+ ceasefire violations. All 251 hostages are accounted for as of January 26, 2026.

media.caption: Israeli High Court sets July 1, 2026 deadline for government to present October 7 investigation framework — 37 days remaining as of May 25, 2026

title: Day 961: NILI Task Force Continues Systematic Elimination of October 7 Perpetrators Through Ceasefire — 'Hundreds' of ~3,000 Participants Killed or Arrested; AI-Assisted Targeting Campaign Operational
detail: On May 25, 2026 (Day 961 / Ceasefire Day 228), Israel's NILI task force — a secret joint unit run by Shin Bet and Mossad, revealed by the Wall Street Journal on May 21–22 — continued its systematic campaign to kill or capture every identified participant in the October 7, 2023 attack. NILI is a Hebrew acronym for 'Netzach Yisrael Lo Yeshaker' ('The Eternal One of Israel does not lie'), reflecting the unit's ethos that no perpetrator will be forgotten or escape accountability. The task force maintains a comprehensive database of all approximately 3,000 participants in the October 7 massacre, compiled through facial recognition technology, cellphone data, seized Hamas documents, and testimony from returned hostages and detainees. Two independent pieces of evidence identifying an individual as a participant are sufficient for a death warrant — without a trial. 'Hundreds' have been crossed off the list across the ceasefire period. Officials described it as 'one of the most personal and highly technical targeting campaigns in the history of warfare.' The campaign continued after IDF Chief of Staff Zamir confirmed on May 16, 2026 the elimination of Izz al-Din al-Haddad — the last senior October 7 architect known to remain alive in Gaza, head of Hamas's military wing. Former hostages personally held by al-Haddad — Omri Miran, Liri Albag, Emily Damari — described 'closure.' The NILI campaign continues through the active Phase One ceasefire (October 10, 2025–present), representing Israel's asymmetric accountability effort operating in parallel to the stalled diplomatic accountability process. Critics, including international human rights organizations and some bereaved families, maintain that targeted eliminations cannot substitute for a full independent commission examining Israeli government and intelligence failures.

media.caption: Israel's secret NILI task force — Shin Bet/Mossad joint unit with list of all ~3,000 October 7 participants; 'hundreds' eliminated or arrested through ceasefire
